messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-prod p99_latency > 1.2s (slo: 500ms) — 3 identical alerts in 5m, autoclear=off :rotating_light:
Alex K.: acked. I'm looking into it now. Which region?
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-72912 created, urgency=high, responders=eng-oncall
Maria S.: seeing p95->p99 tail on inference nodes in eu-west-1, traces point to heavy KV cache misses + small-batch thrash
Samir: confirming. Metrics: per-shard batch size dropped to 1-2, queue latency spiked. Probably autoscaler churned GPU pool.
Jai Patel: can we confirm autoscaler events? /logs from cluster?
Alex K.: pulling autoscaler log now. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T02:14:22Z autoscaler: pool=inf-gpu-pool action=scale_down reason=idle_predicted replicas=4->2
2026-03-14T02:15:07Z autoscaler: pool=inf-gpu-pool action=scale_up reason=sudden_load replicas=2->6
2026-03-14T02:15:08Z serving: route=inference-stream batching=continuous kv_cache_miss_rate=0.78 p99=1.8s
```
Alex K.: yeah looks like rapid down/up caused lots of cold KV cache + tiny batches -> per-token cost and latency spike.
Leah (oncall): any customer impact? Support reports 3 customer incidents, mostly chat stops and timeouts.
Maria S.: partial impact for long-context chat and streaming. Non-critical for embeddings.
Samir: mitigation options — immediate: pause autoscaler, enable warmed standby, or flip route to a heavier but warmer model variant. Longer: tune scale cooldowns and batching policy.
Jai Patel: can we circuit-break small batch path? Temporary throttle to force batching threshold to 8 tokens or fall back to queued batching?
Alex K.: I can flip a per-route config to disable continuous small-batch flush: command:
```
redwoodctl routes update inference-stream --batching-mode=queued --min-batch-size=8
```
Alex K.: doing that now.
IncidentBot: Config change submitted by Alex K. — job id 82471.
Alex K.: changed. monitoring…
Maria S.: within 20s p99 dropped to 0.6s on the affected hosts. Nice.
Samir: autoscaler still flapping though. Recommend setting pool.min_replicas=3 for 10m window to avoid future cold thrash.
Leah (oncall): agreed. Can someone patch autoscaler quickly? If not, I'll set an interim lock.
Alex K.: applying interim lock:
```
kubectl -n infra annotate deployment autoscaler redwood-autoscaler "redwood/temp-lock=true" --overwrite
kubectl -n infra scale deployment inf-gpu-pool --replicas=4
```
Alex K.: done. autoscaler temporarily locked and pool scaled to 4.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-72912 status=acknowledged by Alex K.
Maria S.: telemetry shows p99 now ~0.45s, error rate back to baseline. Looks like mitigations worked.
Samir: I'll follow up after stabilization with a postmortem note: root cause = aggressive scale-down cooldown + continuous-batching sensitivity to cold KV caches. Proposed remediation: longer cooldown, warm standbys, and a batching safety circuit.
Leah (oncall): handing off to Samir for overnight watch. Samir, please keep PD snoozed and escalate if p99 > 800ms for 5m.
Samir: taking handoff. PD snoozed for 45m. I'll post updates.
Alex K.: filing quick incident summary in #incidents and pinging solutions for customer followup.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-72912 update: mitigated, status=monitoring.
Leah (oncall): thanks team :heart: — please add any follow-up action items to the incident ticket.
